title: tehas start --json
description: What tehas start <issue> --json and tehas start <issue> --clear --json print, version 1: the approval recorded or taken back. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples beside this file against it and what the command prints.

approval.description: The approval recorded, or the one --clear took back. null from a --clear that found none.
